title: Copy source register
statement: For a natural number $K_0$, the source-register map assigns a register among $0$ through $16$ to each copy site. It sends the radius copy to the radius register for its stage, the logarithm copy to register $1$, each indexed addition copy to register $4$, the width-counter copy to register $5$, both base-copy sites to register $6$, the base-access copy to register $7$, the index-access copy to the register assigned to its site (register $9$ for reading or marking $V$, and register $8$ otherwise), and the iteration copy to register $2$.
hypotheses_covered: Copy site; indexed additions use an index below $K_0$
